mapper.select: SELECT total_amount FROM payment_info WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_session ( session_id, product_variant_id, quantity, user_id, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{productVariantId}, #{quantity}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT ps.product_variant_id AS productVariantId, v.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, cat.name AS categoryName, v.option_label AS optionLabel, ps.quantity AS quantity, v.price AS price, p.shipping_price AS shippingPrice, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'GALLERY' ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl FROM payment_session ps LEFT JOIN product_variant v ON ps.product_variant_id = v.product_variant_id LEFT JOIN product p ON v.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE ps.session_id = #{sessionId} AND ps.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_info ( session_id, order_id, user_id, total_price, total_shipping_price, total_amount, sender_name, sender_phone, recipient_name, recipient_phone, zonecode, road_address, detail_address, delivery_request, delivery_request_detail, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{totalShippingPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{senderName}, #{senderPhone}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zonecode}, #{roadAddress}, #{detailAddress}, #{deliveryRequest}, #{deliveryRequestDetail}, #{expiresAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = #{orderId}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, total_shipping_price = #{totalShippingPrice}, total_amount = #{totalShippingPrice}, sender_name = #{senderName}, sender_phone = #{senderPhone}, recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_phone = #{recipientPhone}, zonecode = #{zonecode}, road_address = #{roadAddress}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, delivery_request = #{deliveryRequest}, delivery_request_detail = #{deliveryRequestDetail}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}
